artworks.title: Ambassadors Sent to Achilles
artworks.description: Villenave's embassy — Odysseus, Phoenix, and Ajax at the Myrmidon camp when Agamemnon tried to buy back the best of the Achaeans.

artworks.title: Achilles Rejecting the Envoys
artworks.description: Achilles with the lyre — Book 9's refusal that kept the son of Peleus idle while the ships burned.
